id: \bKiawe: I have successfully beaten Tapu Fini's trial. Let me show you my new power.
en: \bKiawe: I have successfully beaten Tapu Fini's trial.  Let me show you my new power.
it: \bKiawe: Ho superato la prova di Tapu Fini.  Lascia che ti mostri il mio nuovo potere.

id: \bKiawe: Good luck with your own trial.
en: \bKiawe: Good luck with your own trial.
it: \bKiawe: Buona fortuna con la tua prova.
